families.name: PokeB_LongTerraceStairs
families.note: Twelve narrow gray treads; brown stringers. Upper plaza flight.

families.name: PokeB_SideTerraceStairs
families.note: Eight treads in the oblique east-facing flight; rotate the uphill axis to match.

families.name: PokeC_VillageStairs
families.note: Six olive stone treads between brown edging at the western village center.

families.name: PokeC_WideVillageStairs
families.note: Wider six-step western terrace flight.

families.name: PokeC_LongVillageStairs
families.note: Ten-step southern descent, preserving its longer run.

families.name: PokeC_UpperVillageStairs
families.note: Short eastern flight below the large house; terrain staircase, separate from its doorway.

families.name: PokeD_RoughStoneStairs
families.note: Six broad rounded stone treads nested between rough rock shoulders.

families.name: PokeD_StairLanding
families.note: Complete lower eastern cobbled terrace with masonry support, parapets and a side flight; hidden underside and rear are inferred.

families.name: PokeF_TallTerraceStairs
families.note: Eight silver-gray treads with red-brown stringers; northern clipped copy reuses this family.

families.name: PokeF_LowTerraceStairs
families.note: Four-step terrace west of the clinic, not its entrance.

families.name: PokeG_TerraceStairs
families.note: Six pale treads and golden timber edging at the town upper terrace.

families.name: PokeG_SideTerraceStairs
families.note: Longer side-on staircase beside the upper house; paired timber stringers.

families.name: PokeH_FieldStairs
families.note: Four-step field terrace flight; side-facing field copies reuse this geometry rotated.

families.name: PokeI_FarmStairs
families.note: Repeated short flights; uses the newer building calibration of 9.5 displayed pixels per tile.

families.name: PokeJ_ForestStairs
families.note: Both forest flights share eight gray treads. Scale follows the building calibration.

families.name: PokeK_LakesideStairs
families.note: Three repeated flights. Tree repeats are two tiles across: 29.4 displayed pixels = two tiles, correcting the older tree note for this collection.

families.name: PokeM_StoneStairs
families.note: Six warm gray treads, pale stone curbs and end piers.

families.name: PokeM_DoubleStoneStairs
families.note: Two six-step flights separated by a short landing, complete as one model.

families.name: PokeN_TwoStepStairs
families.note: Two broad olive treads and short timber edging on the upper house path.

families.name: PokeP_GullyStairs
families.note: Gray side-on terrain stair with orange-brown stringers beside the lower plank bridge. Distinct from the bridge.

families.name: PokeQ_SummitBambooStairs
families.note: Four broad timber treads with green segmented bamboo edging below the summit.

families.name: PokeQ_LongBambooStairs
families.note: Ten-step lower island flight, with continuous paired bamboo stringers.

families.name: PokeR_GardenStairs
families.note: Three shallow pale treads; northern path and commercial garden reuse this family.

families.name: PokeS_MossyTerrainStairs
families.note: Repeated six-step outdoor rock cuts, outside the already authored sanctuaries. Low rough shoulders with restrained moss.

families.name: PokeS_ShortTerrainStairs
families.note: Short eastern three-step descent; not a separate temple entrance.

families.name: PokeT_CaveStairs
families.note: Six warm stone treads with pale curbs; repeated cave-bank side views reuse rotations. No cave wall or mouth included.
